cybersecurity.oversight: the Audit Committee of the Board of Directors

scenario.summary: Meridian Innovations maintains a deliberately thin equity base (approximately 2.0% of total assets) funded by an ongoing debt-financed share repurchase program, a capital allocation strategy rather than a sign of distress, though it leaves the company with elevated financial leverage.

facts.driver: an ongoing share repurchase program funded substantially through debt issuance
facts.framing: a deliberate capital allocation choice reflecting confidence in cash flow generation, not financial distress
facts.risk_noted: the resulting leverage increases vulnerability to adverse changes in interest rates or operating performance
